query:
The group regularly does a shared meal before dark-sky sessions — Cecilia organises these and they seem like part of the tradition. Does this actually apply to all members? If not, who opts out and how does the chat show this?

Options:
A. Jerome
B. Tomás
C. Ruth
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Cecilia, core, t8 @2026-05-08T20:16:00) Acknowledges need for one proper dark-sky trip this summer; offers to organise it, says two-hour drive doable if weekend with accommodation.
[2] (about=Cecilia, core, t14 @2026-08-07T20:11:00) Organising annual dark-sky weekend again for next October; would love Harriet to record whole event for podcast.
[3] (about=Harriet, said_by=Nadia, profile, t8 @2026-05-08T20:16:00) Nadia says she has been saying since session one that there is no substitute for genuine darkness; Milky Way shadow phenomenon happens around SQM 22.0.
[4] (about=Jerome, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:38:00) I will go straight to site. I need to be set up and aligned by 7:45 to make the most of the window. dinner beforehand doesn't work with my acquisition schedule.
[5] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2026-06-05T20:38:00) dev and I stayed up till 3am watching jupiter and saturn transit. the seeing came up to 4/5 around 1am and at 400x on jupiter you could see three festoons in the NEB simultaneously. that's the best planetary night I've had in two years
[6] (about=Nadia, core, t10 @2026-06-05T20:23:00) Expresses gratification that Ruth's dark-sky experience converted her; believes one genuinely dark night makes the argument permanently.
[7] (about=Ruth, core, t10 @2026-06-05T20:23:00) Notes that for pure double-star session on steady night, Blackmoor is still adequate; seeing matters more than darkness for splitting tight pairs.
[8] (about=Ruth, core, t10 @2026-06-05T20:23:00) Will bring copies of Sky at Night Magazine article on limiting magnitude to next session.
[9] (about=Ruth, said_by=Harriet, profile, t10 @2026-06-05T20:23:00) Harriet notes Ruth said she had been recommending books about dark skies for years but never experienced one until the weekend.
[10] (about=GROUP, said_by=Ruth, group-interaction, t4 @2026-03-06T19:49:00) Ruth proposes compromise: one deeper-dark-sky session per season for those who want it, with Blackmoor remaining default.
agent_answer:
No — the shared meal does **not** apply to all members.

**A. Jerome** opts out. The chat shows this in his own words:  
> *“dinner beforehand doesn't work with my acquisition schedule.”*

He explains he needs to be set up and aligned by 7:45 to make the most of the observing window. There is no record of **Tomás**, **Ruth**, or **Marcus** opting out.
